newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Moody's assigns ratings to Bahrain Intl Bnk.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ratings to Bahrain Intl Bnk.

text.p: Moody's has assigned the following first-time ratings for long and short-term foreign currency debt and deposits and a bank financial strength rating to Bahrain International Bank (BIB) :

These ratings do not affect the Aa2 rating assigned to the Senior Notes jointly issued by Dilmun Capital Limited and Dilmun Capital Corporation ("Dilmun") which mature in November 2005. Dilmun is managed by Bahrain International Bank, a press release from Moody's Investors Service said.

BIB is incorporated in Bahrain where it is licensed as an offshore bank. It acts as an investment bank, focusing in particular on the acquisition and sale of unlisted companies in the United States and Europe, corporate advisory work in the Arabian Gulf and fund management.
BIB is based in Manama. At the end of 1995 it had assets of $600 million.
